mt5.description: Basic Attention Token vs US Dollar

narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -14.88 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.07490-0.07498 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.07637; the first objective pays 1.40R at 0.07433.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.07637 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.40 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 34/100 — trend broken, ask-wall ceiling, funding still cool

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding: no per-venue OI available — oiWeightedRate8h is the equal-weight mean
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
